introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: Nidal Alrouh ("we", "us", or "our") is a community-driven peer support platform designed to create a safe space for individuals in Morocco to share experiences, find solidarity, and support one another. We are committed to protecting your privacy and handling your personal data with the utmost care and transparency.

platformNature.title: Nature of Our Platform
platformNature.important: IMPORTANT: Nidal Alrouh is a community peer-support platform, NOT a professional healthcare service.
points: We provide a space for community members to support each other
We do NOT offer professional medical, psychological, or therapeutic services
We do NOT provide diagnosis, treatment, or professional counseling
Content shared is for peer support and informational purposes only
In case of emergency, please contact professional services: 141 (Medical), 19 (Police), or 0801 00 47 47 (Crisis Hotline)

dataController.title: Data Controller
dataController.content: Nidal Alrouh operates as the data controller for personal information collected through our platform. We are in the process of completing registration with the Commission Nationale de Contrôle de la Protection des Données à Caractère Personnel (CNDP) in accordance with Moroccan LawNo. 09-08.
dataController.note: This platform is currently in beta/pre-launch phase. Full CNDP registration will be completed before public launch.

account.title: Account Information
items: Email address (required for account recovery only)

anonymous.title: Anonymous Publishing
features: You can create posts without revealing your identity
Anonymous posts are not linked to your profile
We maintain anonymity even in our databases
No third parties can identify anonymous contributors

dataUse.title: How We Use Your Information
purposes: To provide and maintain our community platform
To enable peer-to-peer support and interaction
To improve platform security and prevent abuse
To analyze platform usage and improve our services
dataUse.noSelling: We will NEVER sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties.

dataSecurity.title: Data Security & Encryption
dataSecurity.commitment: We take your data security seriously and implement industry-standard protection measures:
measures: Encrypted storage for journal entries and mood data
Secure HTTPS connections for all data transmission
dataSecurity.note: While we implement robust security measures, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure. We cannot guarantee absolute security but are committed to protecting your data to the best of our ability.

dataRetention.title: Data Retention
dataRetention.policy: We retain your personal data only as long as necessary for the purposes outlined in this policy:
periods: Account data: Until you delete your account
Content: Until you delete it or request removal
Backup data: Maximum 30 days after deletion request

yourRights.title: Your Rights
yourRights.intro: Under Moroccan Law No. 09-08, you have the following rights:
rights: Right to Access: Request a copy of your personal data
Right to Rectification: Correct inaccurate or incomplete data
Right to Deletion: Request deletion of your data ('right to be forgotten')
Right to Object: Object to processing of your data
Right to Data Portability: Receive your data in a structured format
Right to Withdraw Consent: Withdraw your consent at any time
Right to Lodge a Complaint: File a complaint with CNDP
yourRights.exercise: To exercise these rights, contact us at: privacy@nidal-alrouh.ma

dataSharing.title: Data Sharing & Third Parties
dataSharing.policy: We do NOT share your personal data with third parties except:
exceptions: To comply with legal obligations or court orders
To protect rights, property, or safety of our users
With service providers bound by confidentiality (e.g., hosting, security)
dataSharing.international: We do not currently transfer data outside Morocco. If this changes, we will obtain CNDP authorization and update this policy.

cookies.title: Cookies & Tracking
cookies.description: We use essential cookies for platform functionality:
types: Authentication cookies (to keep you logged in)
cookies.analytics: We do NOT use third-party analytics or advertising cookies without your consent.

children.title: Children's Privacy
children.policy: Our platform is intended for users aged 18 and above. We do not knowingly collect data from individuals under 18. If we discover such data has been collected, we will delete it immediately.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.policy: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any significant changes by:
methods: Posting the new policy on this page
Sending an email notification (for material changes)
changes.review: We encourage you to review this policy periodically.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.intro: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise your rights, please contact us:
contact.cndp: For complaints regarding data protection, you may also contact CNDP: www.cndp.ma

beta.title: Beta Platform Notice
beta.notice: This platform is currently in beta/pre-launch phase. We are actively working towards full compliance with all Moroccan data protection regulations, including completing our CNDP registration. Your participation during this phase helps us build a safer, more supportive community.

termsOfService.title: Terms of Service
termsOfService.acceptance: By accessing or using Nidal Alrouh, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please do not use our platform.

platform.title: 1. Platform Nature & Purpose
points: Peer Support Only: Nidal Alrouh is a community peer-support platform designed for individuals to share experiences, offer mutual support, and build solidarity.
NOT Professional Healthcare: We do NOT provide professional medical, psychological, psychiatric, or therapeutic services.
NOT a Substitute: Our platform is NOT a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.
No Professional Relationship: No doctor-patient, therapist-client, or professional-client relationship is created through use of this platform.
Emergency Services: In case of medical or psychiatric emergency, immediately contact emergency services (141, 19) or the National Crisis Hotline (0801 00 47 47).

eligibility.title: 2. Eligibility
requirements: You must be at least 18 years old to use this platform
You must provide accurate information during registration
You must not be prohibited from using the service under Moroccan law
You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account

accounts.title: 3. User Accounts
rules: Registration: You may create one account per person
Username: You may choose an anonymous username to protect your identity
Security: You are responsible for maintaining your password confidentiality
Accuracy: You must provide a valid email address for account recovery
Prohibited: Do not share your account credentials with others
Termination: We reserve the right to terminate accounts that violate these terms

userContent.title: 4. User-Generated Content
userContent.ownership: You retain ownership of content you create. By posting, you grant us a non-exclusive license to display and distribute your content on the platform.
responsibilities: You are responsible for all content you post
Accuracy: Do not post false or misleading information
No Medical Advice: Do not provide medical diagnosis, treatment, or prescriptions
Respectful: Content must comply with our Community Guidelines
Legal: Content must comply with Moroccan law

prohibited.title: Prohibited Content
items: Encouragement or instruction for self-harm or suicide

anonymity.title: 5. Anonymous Publishing
anonymity.feature: We offer anonymous publishing to protect your privacy:
terms: Anonymous posts are not publicly linked to your profile
We maintain technical separation between anonymous and identified content
Anonymous publishing does not exempt you from our Community Guidelines
We may remove anonymous content that violates our terms
In cases of legal obligation or serious  safety concerns, we may be required to disclose information to authorities

privacy.title: 6. Privacy & Data Protection
privacy.commitment: We are committed to protecting your privacy:
points: We encrypt sensitive data including journals and private messages
We are pursuing CNDP registration in accordance with Law No. 09-08
See our Privacy Policy for detailed information

moderation.title: 7. Content Moderation
moderation.policy: To maintain a safe and supportive community, we moderate content:
actions: We use automated filters to detect prohibited content
Users can report content that violates guidelines
We may remove content that violates these terms
We may suspend or terminate accounts for repeated violations
Decisions may be appealed through our contact channels

liability.title: 8. Limitation of Liability
disclaimers: No Professional Advice: Content on this platform is for peer support only and does not constitute professional advice
User Responsibility: Users are solely responsible for their decisions and actions
No Guarantees: We make no guarantees about the accuracy, reliability, or effectiveness of user-generated content
Platform Availability: We do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free service
Third-Party Content: We are not responsible for content posted by users
No Liability: To the fullest extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any damages arising from use of this platform

intellectualProperty.title: 9. Intellectual Property
intellectualProperty.platform: The Nidal Alrouh platform, including design, features, and branding, is our intellectual property.
intellectualProperty.userContent: You retain ownership of your content but grant us a license to use it on the platform.
intellectualProperty.restrictions: You may not copy, modify, distribute, or create derivative works of our platform without permission.

termination.title: 10. Termination
rights: Your Right: You may delete your account at any time
Our Right: We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms
Effect: Upon termination, your right to use the platform ceases
Data: See our Privacy Policy for information about data retention after termination

governingLaw.title: 11. Governing Law & Disputes
governingLaw.law: These Terms are governed by the laws of the Kingdom of Morocco.
governingLaw.jurisdiction: Any disputes shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of Moroccan courts.
governingLaw.resolution: We encourage users to contact us first to resolve disputes amicably.

changes.title: 12. Changes to Terms
changes.policy: We may update these Terms of Service. Significant changes will be communicated via email or platform notification. Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance.

contact.title: 13. Contact Information
contact.email: For questions about these Terms: legal@nidal-alrouh.ma

beta.title: 14. Beta Platform Acknowledgment
beta.notice: You acknowledge that this platform is currently in beta/pre-launch phase. Features may change, and temporary disruptions may occur as we work towards full compliance with Moroccan regulations and complete our CNDP registration.
